en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al A’la Bin Al Fuzayl,

(The narrator) says, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The man denies from his child, and he had previously acknowledge with it. So heasws said: ‘If the child was from a free woman, he would be whipped the Penalty (Hadd) of fifty lashes, a Penalty (Hadd) of the owned (slaves), and if it was from a slave girl, so there is nothing upon him’.
